title: Iceberg Underneath (Post-Workout Bar)
bars:
Two percent above the water, ninety-eight in the dark,
They only count the lightning when the server catches a spark.
Every ledger in the tower got a ghost in the sheet,
I'm running tempo up the Escarpment just to measure the beat.

title: Cold Air, High NEAT
bars:
Sixteen thousand steps before the sun clears the frost,
Count the deficit in chalk dust, never count what it cost.
Plate loaded to the collar, twelve reps on the bar,
Keep the notebook in the gym bag where the blueprints are.

title: Ballot Box / Fault Line
bars:
Ten questions on the paper, three-to-one on the stay,
Half the room wants a megaphone, half wants a way.
Draw the border in the oil sand, draw it in the poll,
Everybody wants the leverage till you tally the toll.
